description: Skirt clearance, registered start bearings, and explicit speed versus first-layer fallback through public Print export.

mutants.description: Zero the configured skirt_distance contribution at the initial skirt-centerline offset; the zero-distance row remains a control while nonzero configured clearances should fail.
Ignore the configured angle in the first-layer start-point selection; nonzero requested bearings should fail while same-root geometry and feed-speed checks remain controls.
Clamp the positive override to its pre-override fallback; the registered 37 mm/s rows should fail and the zero-override 23 mm/s row should remain a control.
